name: Biddeford, Maine
description: I was born here. My dad worked at the new Pratt & Whitney plant, and my mom was a legal assistant and trial manager in the York County courts. I sang in the choir, played sports, and somehow ended up captain of every team I was on from age 8 to 18. In middle school, a friend and I started a DJ business, playing dances at other middle schools.

name: New York, New York
description: I came for Hofstra University and started in international business, then switched to psychology after getting hooked on the psychology of business. I also temped at a range of Manhattan firms.

name: Portland, Maine
description: Back in Maine to prepare for law school, I worked at a state psychiatric hospital while studying for the LSAT. I got so into the work that I dropped the LSAT and took the GRE.

name: Chicago, Illinois
description: I came for graduate school in behavior analysis and worked as a paraprofessional serving children with autism. I did a practicum under T.V. Joe Layng, Headsprout's founder, then joined Headsprout and spent years traveling between Seattle, Chicago, and Tennessee, leading district rollouts. I also worked with the Chicago Academy for Advanced Technology and on behavioral safety projects with the Chicago DOT, and stayed on with Learning A-Z after the acquisition.

name: Tucson, Arizona
description: Bob Holl, Learning A-Z's founder, asked me to move here to lead R&D. Soon after, he announced his retirement and asked me to succeed him as president.

name: Dallas, Texas
description: Cambium and Voyager Sopris were headquartered here, and I was spending so much time in Dallas leading Voyager Sopris that I moved there.

name: Minneapolis–St. Paul
description: We moved after COVID so our newborn daughter could grow up close to her grandparents. As a lifelong Vikings fan, I didn't need much convincing. I co-founded Lessi here, and it's home.
